About this item

  • Deep Clean Technology: Equipped with Sonicare Fluid Action, this Philips Sonicare 5950 Series Electric Toothbrush pushes fluid between your teeth and gums to reach those hard-to-clean areas; ideal for those making the upgrade from manual
  • Pressure Sensor Protection: The built-in pressure sensor helps protect your gums by sending haptic feedback the moment you press too hard; you'll feel a gentle pulse so you can ease up and keep gums comfortable
  • C3 Two-in-one Brush Heads: Features gumline and stiff, dense bristles that deliver up to 1000% more plaque removal¹ and up to 100% healthier gums²; designed for effective cleaning with a gentle touch
  • Smart Session Timers: BrushPacer reminds you to clean a new area every 20 seconds, while the SmartTimer indicates your 2 minute session is complete; helps you build a consistent brushing habit
  • Customizable Brushing Modes: Equipped with 6 brushing settings including 2 modes—Clean and Gum Health (ideal when gums feel sensitive)—plus 3 intensity levels so you can tailor every session to your needs
  • Extended Battery Life: This rechargeable toothbrush gives you up to 21 days of regular brushing on one full charge; includes a travel case to protect your handle whether you're on a trip or traveling for work

Product Description

The Philips Sonicare 5950 Series combines effective cleaning with a gentle touch for those with sensitive gums, busy routines, and a focus on value. The C3 Two-in-one brush head delivers up to 1000% more plaque removal¹ and up to 100% healthier gums², ideal if your dentist has recommended switching to electric or you're making the upgrade from manual. Behind that, the motor delivers 62,000 bristle movements per minute, while Next-Generation Sonicare Technology and Sonicare Fluid Action drive fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline for a thorough clean that reaches where bristles alone cannot. The built-in pressure sensor sends haptic feedback to alert you when you're pressing too hard, so gums stay protected during every session. Choose from 6 brushing settings across two modes, Clean and Gum Health, along with three intensity levels that let you dial in exactly the clean you need. BrushPacer prompts you every 20 seconds to move to a new area, while the SmartTimer signals when you've completed your full 2 minute session. A single charge gives you up to 21 days of regular brushing, and the included travel case protects the handle whether you're traveling for work or on vacation. A brush head replacement reminder tracks your cleaning habits and alerts you every 3 months when it's time for a new head. ¹ vs. a manual toothbrush ² in Clean mode vs. a manual toothbrush in 2 weeks

  • How does the pressure sensor feedback work on my Sonicare toothbrush?

    Your Sonicare toothbrush measures the pressure you apply while brushing to protect your gums and teeth. If you apply too much pressure, the handle will change its vibration.

  • How do I know when to replace the brush head?

    Your Sonicare toothbrush will track the wear of your smart brush head, using the BrushSync technology. It measures the overall pressure you apply while brushing, and the total time you have brushed with your brush head.

  • Can I use my Philips Sonicare Toothbrush in the shower?

    It is completely safe to use your Philips Sonicare Toothbrush in the shower. Allow the toothbrush to air-dry between uses. Also, do not place the charger where it might risk contact with water.

  • How does the BrushPacer work on my Philips Sonicare Toothbrush?

    The BrushPacer divides brushing time into six equal segments and indicates when you should move to the next area. Segments are indicated with a brief pause in vibration. The toothbrush automatically stops at the end of the brushing session.

  • How to clean my Philips Sonicare toothbrush?

    Cleaning your toothbrush and brush heads regularly improves their lifespan and performance. Clean your toothbrush after use by rinsing your brush head and bristles. Wipe the handle with a damp cloth.

    So far, I am pleased with this electric toothbrush. I don’t think I’ve even explored the different modes yet (like the gum care mode), but I really just need it to perform its basic function of brushing my teeth.

    I haven’t updated my electric toothbrush in many years. I had an older model of the same brand, and it just seemed like the motor/batter had gotten weak and it wasn’t functioning that well anymore.

    I was definitely correct because this new Philips Sonicare packs much more of a punch compared to my old one. It was almost a little too much at first but I just needed a couple of days to adjust and now it’s great. I’ve noticed my teeth feel incredibly smooth all day long, like they do immediately after I go for a cleaning at the dentist. Now I regret not updating sooner because I think this will be great for my dental hygiene.

    I got this on a prime day sale so it is absolutely worth the money, however having used it now I would have been happy paying full price for the update in quality compared to my old brush. I haven’t been able to test the battery life yet, but we have travel coming up so I am happy that it comes with a travel case.

    Personally I love the modern look of the black brush, but it was hard to choose a color. It actually does feel nice to hold as well, when comparing it to my old one. It is slightly smaller and sleeker and slightly lighter weight. But not so light that it feels cheap, it still seems solid.

    Obviously I haven’t had it long enough to know how long it will last. But the old one (which again was the same brand) was still going after almost a decade. So if I get that long out of it, I will be very happy.

    As an Amazon Vine Voice reviewer, I have tested my fair share of personal care devices, and the Philips Sonicare 5950 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush immediately sets a high bar. Out of the box, you can tell this is a top tier, premium product with a lot of thought put into the engineering and design.

    The matte black finish looks sleek on the bathroom counter, but more importantly, the build quality feels incredibly solid. The handle has a nice weight to it, offering a comfortable, ergonomic grip that does not feel slippery when wet. The buttons have a satisfying click with zero play, and the brush heads snap on with a tight, precise fit. It feels durable and well sealed against water, which is essential for long term use.

    When it comes to performance, it leaves your teeth with that fresh, dentist clean feel every single time. The sonic vibration power is strong and consistent without feeling harsh on your gums, and the pressure sensor works like a charm to let you know if you are pressing too hard. Having the two brush heads included in the box is a great touch, making it ready for months of use right away.

    The battery life is equally impressive. A single full charge easily lasts for weeks of twice daily brushing, making it super convenient for travel without having to haul extra cords around.

    If you are looking for a high quality, reliable electric toothbrush that looks modern and delivers serious cleaning power, this one is worth every penny. Extremely well made and easily recommended.

About this Item

  • Deep Clean Technology: Equipped with Sonicare Fluid Action, this Philips Sonicare 5950 Series Electric Toothbrush pushes fluid between your teeth and gums to reach those hard-to-clean areas; ideal for those making the upgrade from manual
  • Pressure Sensor Protection: The built-in pressure sensor helps protect your gums by sending haptic feedback the moment you press too hard; you'll feel a gentle pulse so you can ease up and keep gums comfortable
  • C3 Two-in-one Brush Heads: Features gumline and stiff, dense bristles that deliver up to 1000% more plaque removal¹ and up to 100% healthier gums²; designed for effective cleaning with a gentle touch
  • Smart Session Timers: BrushPacer reminds you to clean a new area every 20 seconds, while the SmartTimer indicates your 2 minute session is complete; helps you build a consistent brushing habit
  • Customizable Brushing Modes: Equipped with 6 brushing settings including 2 modes—Clean and Gum Health (ideal when gums feel sensitive)—plus 3 intensity levels so you can tailor every session to your needs
  • Extended Battery Life: This rechargeable toothbrush gives you up to 21 days of regular brushing on one full charge; includes a travel case to protect your handle whether you're on a trip or traveling for work

Product Description

The Philips Sonicare 5950 Series combines effective cleaning with a gentle touch for those with sensitive gums, busy routines, and a focus on value. The C3 Two-in-one brush head delivers up to 1000% more plaque removal¹ and up to 100% healthier gums², ideal if your dentist has recommended switching to electric or you're making the upgrade from manual. Behind that, the motor delivers 62,000 bristle movements per minute, while Next-Generation Sonicare Technology and Sonicare Fluid Action drive fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline for a thorough clean that reaches where bristles alone cannot. The built-in pressure sensor sends haptic feedback to alert you when you're pressing too hard, so gums stay protected during every session. Choose from 6 brushing settings across two modes, Clean and Gum Health, along with three intensity levels that let you dial in exactly the clean you need. BrushPacer prompts you every 20 seconds to move to a new area, while the SmartTimer signals when you've completed your full 2 minute session. A single charge gives you up to 21 days of regular brushing, and the included travel case protects the handle whether you're traveling for work or on vacation. A brush head replacement reminder tracks your cleaning habits and alerts you every 3 months when it's time for a new head. ¹ vs. a manual toothbrush ² in Clean mode vs. a manual toothbrush in 2 weeks
